## Omarchy Silicon downstream pull requests

Use GitHub pull requests for changes intended for this Omarchy Silicon downstream repository. Explain the affected board or hardware profile, evidence, and support or release boundaries in the pull request description.

## Upstream U-Boot patches

If a change is intended for upstream U-Boot rather than this downstream, submit and review it through the upstream mailing-list process: [Sending patches](https://u-boot.readthedocs.io/en/latest/develop/sending_patches.html). A downstream GitHub pull request is not an upstream submission.

For program-level coordination, use the [central Issues](https://github.com/omarchy-silicon/omarchy-apple-platform/issues) and [central Discussions](https://github.com/omarchy-silicon/omarchy-apple-platform/discussions). Report vulnerabilities through the [private security advisory channel](https://github.com/omarchy-silicon/omarchy-apple-platform/security/advisories/new).
